name: Vansen Stretch Denim Straight Leg
description: Mid-rise straight jeans with 18% elastane woven into the denim for all-day flexibility. The stretch is invisible — they look like regular jeans, feel like wearing something much more comfortable. Popular with people on their feet all day. Available in light wash and raw indigo.
functionality: Full-range stretch without visible elasticization; holds shape after washing
what_it_says: Function first. You've made the practical choice that still looks decent.
worn_by: anyone on their feet all day
story_hooks: The elastane content means these survive significant physical stress — useful for someone who ends up in a situation they didn't plan for.
A secondhand pair still has a transit worker's ID clipped to the belt loop.
